content: मन्त्रः [मन्त्र्-अच्] .²1 A Vedic hymn or sacred prayer (addressed to any deity), a sacred text; (it is of three kinds:-- it is called ऋच् if metrical and intended to be loudly recited; यजुस् if in prose and muttered in a low tone; and सामन् if, being metrical, it is intended for chanting). .²2 The portion of the Veda including the Samhitā and distinguished from the {%Brāhmaṇa%}; <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 A charm, spell, an incantation; सोऽहमस्मि मन्त्रसिद्धः <ls>Dk. 54</ls>; न हि जीवन्ति जना मनागमन्त्राः <ls>Bv. 1. 111</ls>; अचिन्त्यो हि मणिमन्त्रौषधीनां प्रभावः <ls>Ratn. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 32</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 57</ls>. .²4 A formula (of prayer) sacred to any deity, as ओं नमः शिवाय <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Consultation, deliberation, counsel, advice, resolution, plan; तस्य संवृतमन्त्रस्य <ls>R. 1. 20</ls>; मन्त्रः प्रतिदिनं तस्य बभूव सह मन्त्रिभिः <ls n="R.">17. 50</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 182</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 58</ls>; मन्त्रपूर्वाः सर्वारम्भाः <ls>Kau. A. 1. 15</ls>; also पञ्चाङ्गो मन्त्रः. .²6 Secret plan or consultation, a secret; मन्त्रो योध इवाधीरः सर्वाङ्गैः संवृतैरपि <ls>Śi. 2. 29</ls>. .²7 Policy, statesmanship. .²8 A means, contrivance; किं तु मन्त्रं प्रदास्यामि यो वै तान् निहनिष्यति <ls>Rām. 7. 6. 10</ls>. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²10 of Śiva. .²11 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) The fifth mansion.
